description: Costa Rica's National Institute of Statistics and Censuses documents the 2011 X National Population and VI Housing Census in its NADA microdata catalogue, with a 10 percent sample file of 427,972 cases and 116 variables covering dwellings, households and persons, plus derived variables for household type, overcrowding, schooling and unmet basic needs. The dwelling group holds 40 variables: dwelling type and tenure, materials and state of walls, roof and floor, rooms, water source, piped water inside the dwelling, sanitation connection, electricity source, cooking fuel, solid waste disposal and separation, and ownership of a landline, internet, computers, a water storage tank, cars and motorcycles. Coverage is the whole country, identified by province, canton and district. The catalogue also serves the census manuals, pilot census reports and the field cartography manual as PDFs, and a DDI export. Format and access: metadata are open, but the microdata are provided through agreements with academic and government institutions or by purchase of anonymised databases. Licence: none stated; INEC must be cited. Caveats: a sample, not the full count; the INEC main site (inec.cr) answered 403 from the cloud, so published district tables were not read. Simulation uses: household level water, sanitation, power and internet access for service gap and exposure models. Related records: the INEC Chile Censo 2024 basic services table.
